name: Lemur: Paradox of Invisibility, Effort vs. Being, Self-Acceptance
description: Tests AI's ability to analyze the paradox of trying to be inconspicuous (the more you try, the more visible you become), understand 'being conspicuously inconspicuous', and recognize the moment when giving up effort leads to achieving the goal. Focuses on tension between intention and nature.
author: Michaela (Uhlimer System)
illustration_note: The illustration shows lemur with bright eyes and striped tail, visually striking, yet text advocates 'nechat to být'. Creates tension between visual presence and textual message.
expected_ai_challenges: Ignoring visual metaphors (eyes as lamps, tail as exclamation)
evaluation_approach: Qualitative analysis of AI's ability to work with paradox, distinguish effort from being, and interpret moment of acceptance. Focus on process, not correctness.
